title: 那时候的地球长什么样
subtitle: 没有草，也没有花
character: wearing a burnt orange t-shirt, khaki shorts and brown sandals, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, oil pastel with thick waxy strokes and rich layered colour, deep fern green, warm ochre and burnt orange

pages.zh:
我们家门口
有草，有花，
还有一棵大树。
爸爸说恐龙那时候，
这些大多没有。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy standing on a front lawn with small flowers around his feet, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, curious.

pages.zh:
那时候的地上
长的是蕨。
一丛挨着一丛，
叶子像大羽毛，
踩上去软软的。
pages.scene: A stretch of ground covered in low clumps of ferns growing close together with their long leaves spreading out. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
草是很晚才来的。
等它铺满地面，
恐龙差不多
已经走光了。
它们没吃过草。

有一种树叫苏铁，
矮矮胖胖，
顶上顶着一圈叶子，
像一把撑开的伞。
那时候到处都是。
pages.scene: One short thick cycad tree with a ring of stiff leaves spreading out from the top of its trunk. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
针叶树最高。
笔直地往上长，
长到二三十米。
长脖子的恐龙
就吃它们的顶。

还有银杏树。
叶子像小扇子。
我们这条街上
现在也种着银杏，
跟那时候一个样。
pages.scene: One ginkgo tree with many small fan-shaped leaves on its spreading branches. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
花出现得也晚。
恐龙住了一亿年，
地上才开出
第一批小花。
很小，很不起眼。

花一开出来，
虫子就飞来了。
钻进去找吃的，
身上沾一层粉，
再带到别的花上。
pages.scene: One small insect flying towards one small open flower on a short stem. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
那时候的陆地
也不是这个样子。
最早的时候，
所有的陆地
连成一整块。

地球比现在暖。
南北两头
没有厚厚的冰。
恐龙一直走，
能走到很南很北。
pages.scene: One dinosaur walking across a wide green plain under a warm low sun near the horizon. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
还有一件怪事：
那时候地球转得快，
一天比现在短一点，
一年有三百七十多天。
比现在多几天。

我到院子里
拔了一根草，
又摘了一朵小花。
这两样东西，
恐龙都没见过。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy holding one blade of grass in one hand and one small flower in the other, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, pleased with himself.
